resources.string: When a word looks wrong for its sentence (caza instead of casa), the bar offers the other one · one tap swaps it · the keyboard never changes it on its own · offline

Swipe the space bar up or down to switch between Spanish and English · off by default because it collides with Android\'s home gesture · without it: hold the space bar or use «Idioma»
